title: 3M™ PAINT BUSTER HAND CLEANER 3M™ TAPE AND RESIDUE REMOVER – Paint Buster Hand Cleaner
description: Cream type hand cleaner offers superior performance in the removal of lacquer, enamel and urethane paints, primers, putties, plastic fillers, adhesives, inks and sealants from skin. Apply dry. Do not pre-clean with solvents. Rub hands until soil dissolves, rinse with water and dry.
